decisions.reason: Process data archiving and reporting software builds directly on the firm's in-house automation software expertise and supports its strategic shift toward data-driven, web-based infrastructure management, so the firm can absorb customer feedback and keep developing it, especially after consolidating away the parallel Product B.

Flow measurement automation and system software combines the firm's core water-engineering machinery knowledge with its automation software capabilities, giving it strong absorptive capacity to interpret results and refine the product toward predictive operation.
